# Scoutly — extended public product reference

Site: https://www.scoutly.pro/
Category: browser-based local business prospecting software for teams, agencies and independent commercial operators.
Product pages: https://www.scoutly.pro/recursos/
Sources and reliability: https://www.scoutly.pro/dados-e-fontes/

## Main workflow
1. Select a business category or enter a business name and geographical area.
2. Explore results on the map and open a business profile.
3. Assess available website, publicly sourced contact information, tracking and PageSpeed signals where supported.
4. Save favorites, move relevant leads into the pipeline and follow up using the same business context.
5. When eligible, ask Scoutly Agentic to research or help draft outreach based on the selected lead.

## Users and use cases
Sales teams can discover businesses in a territory; marketing agencies can identify potential client businesses to investigate for website or advertising services; field sales teams can organize routes and follow-up. Information quality must be confirmed before claims are made to a prospective customer.

## Pricing/eligibility constraints
Free accounts receive five prospecting credits per day and a maximum of 25 per month. Full business e-mails, AI and certain enriched features require eligible paid subscriptions. Do not invent monthly prices or assume all features are available on the Free plan.

## Sources and verification
Scoutly can use datasets including Overture Maps, supplemental Serper Places when configured, and direct analysis of available official business websites. Maps and public place data can be incomplete, delayed or incorrect. A phone is not WhatsApp verification. Website tracking scripts might not be detectable due to cookie consent or dynamic loading. The AI can use public search when search integration is configured; possible personal profiles are not confirmed identities without adequate evidence.
